## Exclusions

`main.cpp`, `Provisioning`, the TLSF allocator, `greatest.h`, `CBC` and every
microStore adapter except the POSIX one. See `EXCLUDED` in the script.

## Changes on top of upstream

microReticulum and microStore come from the zerokelvin-dev forks: upstream plus
fixes that are open as upstream PRs
([microReticulum #97, #99–#102](https://github.com/attermann/microReticulum/pulls) and #75,
[microStore #12–#13](https://github.com/attermann/microStore/pulls)). Once they
merge, the pins can move back to upstream. The microReticulum fork also adds
`Destination::set_default_app_data()` (fork PR #7), not yet proposed upstream.

The overlay replaces these files:

- `overlay/microReticulum/Cryptography/`: mbedtls backends for the hashes, HMAC,
  HKDF, AES, Ed25519, X25519 and the random source.
- `overlay/microReticulum/Utilities/Memory.{h,cpp}`: no TLSF pools; containers use
  `operator new`; heap statistics come from `heap_caps_*`.
- `overlay/microReticulum.h`: umbrella header without Provisioning.

## Integration requirements

- `CONFIG_COMPILER_CXX_EXCEPTIONS=y` (the library throws).
- `USTORE_USE_UNIVERSALFS=1`, `RNS_USE_FS=1` (set in `src/CMakeLists.txt`).
- The FAT mount must allow at least 8 open files: each store keeps an index and an
  active segment open, plus one transient descriptor per read.

## Known upstream defects (0.5.0)

- `Random.h` `randomnum` yields 8 bits of entropy per call.
- The HMAC free-digest path feeds the digest twice.
- HKDF ignores its context argument.
- Ed25519/X25519 input sizes are not checked.
- A repeated announce from a known destination does not refresh its stored app data.
